other_failure_modes.description: Monetary amounts (like contract values) are typically highly right-skewed. Training a model with RMSE on raw monetary values often results in poor performance due to sensitivity to outliers. A log or power transform on the target variable is highly recommended.

summary: The agent successfully sets up a K-Fold cross-validation loop with LightGBM and implements basic feature engineering for dates and text. However, it fails to respect the temporal nature of the data, introducing look-ahead bias by shuffling the folds. Furthermore, it completely skips handling missing values, fails to apply a log-transform to the highly skewed monetary target, and neglects to report any validation scores during training.
